label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Advanced SS is explicitly included in the disease criterion and the SS/MRCLS expansion arm.
cohort_reconciliation: Dose escalation precedes disease-specific expansion; SS is within both the stated overall disease list and its named expansion. Part-specific infection exceptions and regional prior-therapy rules are not generalized.
extra_biomarker_requirement: One of nine specified HLA-A*02 alleles is mandatory. Description says HLA-A2 and/or NY-ESO positive, whereas key eligibility explicitly requires HLA and gives no NY-ESO positivity threshold; retain the unresolved NY-ESO testing rule and do not assume expression from SS.
protocol_uncertainty: Only key criteria are supplied; external protocol, NY-ESO testing details and live phases/slots are unverified. Prior NY-ESO-directed therapy is excluded; prior treatment and all clinical constraints remain unassessed.
quotes: participants with HLA-A2 and/or NY-ESO positive.

extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional molecular inclusion gate is stated.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Synovial sarcoma is explicitly named in conditions and is consistent with the open metastatic/locally advanced neoplasia eligibility. The specific name comes from conditions, not a diagnosis-specific eligibility bullet.
cohort_reconciliation: Dose-ranging Part A and expansion Part B share NY-ESO-directed treatment; no narrower disease conflict appears. Narrative sample sizes up to 20 and 43 conflict with estimated enrollment 3; this does not establish active expansion availability.

protocol_uncertainty: External protocol, product feasibility and live part availability are unverified. Ages 18–70, prior therapy, incurability and other clinical criteria remain applicable; differing lymphodepletion descriptions are not resolved here.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Synovial sarcoma is explicitly listed in both Phase Ia and Phase Ib eligibility.
cohort_reconciliation: Phase Ia permits up to three prior chemotherapy lines and measurable or nonmeasurable disease; Phase Ib specifies SS with one to two prior chemotherapy lines and progression, plus its assessment requirements. These stages are not interchangeable.
extra_biomarker_requirement: The separate deleterious germline BRCA1/2-tumor route in Phase Ia is not a required SS biomarker. No additional SS molecular gate is stated.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and active stage are unverified. Prior trabectedin, lurbinectedin or ecubectedin is excluded. Serum-marker assessment references to cancers absent from the Phase Ib disease list are retained as a record inconsistency, not used to broaden histology scope.
quotes: Sarcoma: liposarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, synovial sarcoma and Ewing sarcoma.
